newsitem.title: CANADA: Emco to sell C$75 mln 6.5 pct of conv debt.
newsitem.headline: Emco to sell C$75 mln 6.5 pct of conv debt.

text.p: Emco Ltd said on Monday that it had agreed to sell C$75 million of 6.5 percent convertible debentures in a bought deal with a group of underwriters lead managed by CIBC-Wood Gundy Securities Inc.
Emco said the conversion price will be C$19.75 per Emco common share for a ratio of 50.633 common shares per C$1,000 principal amount of debentures.
The company said the C$1,000 principal amount is payable upon closing, which is expected on or about July 4, 1997.
Emco said proceeds of the offering will be used to fund acquisitions, redeem some outstanding debentures and general corporate purposes.
The offer is subject to all requisite regulatory approvals.
